title: Bilinear external Alexander--Whitney maps on individual tensor summands
statement: Let k be a field, f:X→Spec k and g:Y→Spec k, arbitrary open families U indexed by ι and V indexed by κ, and modules F,G on X,Y. For each p,q in ℕ there exists a k-linear map from C_U(F)^p tensor_k C_V(G)^q to C_W(pr₁*F tensor pr₂*G)^(p+q), where W_(i,j)=pr₁⁻¹U_i intersect pr₂⁻¹V_j and the complexes are those of [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models]. Its coordinate on a pure tensor a tensor b and tuple y is the tensor of the front F coordinate and back G coordinate, pulled along the normalized adjunction units [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] and restricted to the full product intersection, with faces [def-sc-cech-cup-product]. No differential compatibility is asserted.

source.place: Equation 33.29.1.1 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07MB, equation 20.25.3.2; official pages read on 2026-10-13

proof.text: The adjoint of exists_scalarPullbackCoefficient from [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations] is a k-linear section map with the normalized tensor-pullback unit formula. Compose it with scalar restriction and the Cech coordinate projection for each front or back intersection. The pullback condition identifies the structure maps for the second projection.

Tensor the two section maps and compose with scalarTensorCoefficientApp. Assemble these coordinate morphisms using the categorical product universal property. The chosen product opens and infimum opens are related by inverse restrictions, so the output coordinate is the tensor section of the two unit sections. All maps are explicit; empty index families, p=q=0 and zero coefficients require no extra hypothesis.

proof_origin.place: External Cech cup construction; scalar-section assembly and signed-face details written by R4.

theorem picardExternalCechCupBidegree_exists
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (p q : ℕ) :
    ∃ h : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj
          (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + q),
      IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p q h
